:::{#def-nb}
#### Negative binomial distribution

A random variable $Y$ has the **negative binomial distribution**
with mean $\mean > 0$ and overdispersion parameter $\overdisp > 0$,
written $Y \sim \NegBin(\mean, \overdisp)$
[@wikipedia_negative_binomial_distribution],
if, for $y \in \set{0, 1, 2, \dots}$:

$$
\P(Y=y)
\eqdef \frac{\mean^y}{y!}
\cdot \frac{\gammafn(\overdisp + y)}{\gammafn(\overdisp) \cdot (\overdisp + \mean)^y}
\cdot \paren{1+\frac{\mean}{\overdisp}}^{-\overdisp}
$$

where $\gammafn$ is the gamma function,
which satisfies $\gammafn(x) = (x-1)!$ for positive integers $x$.

:::
